segments.an3.131:1.1: “Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, paṭicchannāni āvahanti [vahanti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)], no vivaṭāni.
segments.an3.131:1.3: Mātugāmo, bhikkhave, paṭicchanno āvahati, no vivaṭo;
segments.an3.131:1.4: brāhmaṇānaṃ, bhikkhave, mantā paṭicchannā āvahanti, no vivaṭā;
segments.an3.131:1.5: micchādiṭṭhi, bhikkhave, paṭicchannā āvahati, no vivaṭā.
segments.an3.131:1.6: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi paṭicchannāni āvahanti, no vivaṭāni.
segments.an3.131:2.3: Candamaṇḍalaṃ, bhikkhave, vivaṭaṃ virocati, no paṭicchannaṃ;
segments.an3.131:2.4: sūriyamaṇḍalaṃ, bhikkhave, vivaṭaṃ virocati, no paṭicchannaṃ;
segments.an3.131:2.5: tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo, bhikkhave, vivaṭo virocati, no paṭicchanno.
segments.an3.131:2.6: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi vivaṭāni virocanti, no paṭicchannānī”ti.

lines: Vivaṭo virocatīti ettha ekato ubhato attato sabbatthakatoti catubbidhā vivaṭatā veditabbā.
Navame asādhāraṇasikkhāpadanti bhikkhunīnaṃ asādhāraṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃyeva paññattasikkhāpadaṃ sādhāraṇasikkhāpadanti bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnañca sādhāraṇaṃ ubhatopaññattisikkhāpadaṃ.
